channel.title: Nature Communications
channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [9] Breathing ferroelectricity, flat-bands and multiple chiral phonons in van der Waals breathing kagome Nb3Cl8
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Junhao Chu, Fangyu Yue

Authors: Yilun Yu, Fengrui Sui, Beituo Liu, et al.

Score 9/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Direct hit on Kagome lattice physics, flat-bands, and electronic structure in a vdW material.; demoted from A: broad CM, not direct user/project hit

Tags: #Kagome #Nb3Cl8 #flat-bands #van-der-Waals #ferroelectricity

Abstract: The authors show that van der Waals Nb3Cl8 combines switchable electric polarization, unusual flat electronic bands and chiral lattice vibrations, offering a versatile platform for studying quantum materials and developing nanoscale devices.
